preconditions.description: The dimensions of the city (n, m) must be between 2 and 2000, and the time w must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the city must contain a value between -1 and 10^9.
The starting cell (1, 1) and the ending cell (n, m) must be free (value 0).

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_time) if min_time != float('inf') else '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum time to reach the school, or '-1' if it is not possible.
